Creed is a quirky and somewhat mysterious character at the office. He is considered one of the "old timers" along with Michael, and he often makes cryptic or humorous remarks about his age and situation. For example, he says, "I'm thirty. Well, in November I'll be thirty," and also states, "The only difference between me and a homeless man is this job. I will do whatever it takes to survive. Like I did… when I was a homeless man." Creed seems to have a laid-back attitude and a somewhat shady or unconventional background.

He is involved in office dynamics, such as when Michael has to fire someone and Creed tries to convince him not to fire him, saying, "You will be my savior. You're the guy who gave me my life back." Creed also shows some sly business moves, like when he starts his own paper company and tries to poach clients quietly.

Overall, Creed's "deal" is that he is an eccentric, somewhat enigmatic employee who has a mysterious past and a survivalist mentality, often providing comic relief with his odd comments and behavior (Scenes 014, 015, 028, 029, 033, 056).
